question: Which of the following is the first solar project to break the grid parity barrier in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rewa Ultra Mega Solar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Grid parity is a time at which the electricity cost from the alternative source energy (such as PV or solar) cost is less than or equal to the electrical grid.**
 
• When the power generation is more than 500 MW, then it is called an ultra mega solar park.
 
• **Rewa solar project, set up in Madhya Pradesh becomes the first solar project to break the grid parity barrier in India. Hence option 3 is correct.**
 
 
• ​It is a 750 MW (three units generating 250 MW each) project which was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2020.
 
• **This project is estimated to reduce carbon dioxide emissions to 15 lakh tons per year.**
 
 
 
• It was developed by Rewa Ultra Mega Solar Ltd and Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kurnool Ultra Mega Solar Park in Andhra Pradesh is the world's largest single location operational solar energy park with 1000 MW (250 MW power from each panel) power generation.**

 
 
• ​It was inaugurated by then Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu in Jan 2019.
 
 
 
• **Bhadla Solar Park located in Rajasthan is the world's largest solar park which has a capacity of 2.2 GW or 2240 MW.**
 
 
• ​It was commissioned in 2017 and has more than 10 mn solar panels.
 
 
 
• **Charanka Solar Park located in Gujarat generates around 600 MW** and was inaugurated n 2012 by then Chief Minister of Gujarat Narendra Modi.

d0:T
